summary: Verified new 'Coming Soon to Ananta' promo banner + permanent section on both web and mobile against the shared FastAPI backend. Backend GET/POST /api/promo/coming-soon endpoints work (4/4 pytest passed). Web + mobile UI both render banner (dismiss X, image, Join Waitlist, Learn More) and permanent WHAT'S COMING section; Learn More modal lists all 3 features (Weekly AI Trading Championship, Strategy Marketplace, Advanced AI Strategy Reports); Join Waitlist button switches to 'On the waitlist' (disabled) and persists on backend; web dismiss persists via localStorage across close+reopen while section still shows. Parity confirmed. NOTE: An UNRELATED critical bug was discovered on web — WebOnboarding.jsx uses <AnantaTrident/> but does not import it, so fresh owner login crashes the whole app via ErrorBoundary. I worked around it by pre-setting localStorage 'ananta_onboarded=1'; main agent MUST fix this import.

ui_bugs.issue: ReferenceError: AnantaTrident is not defined at WebOnboarding (bundle line ~145533). WebOnboarding.jsx uses <AnantaTrident size=56/> on line 65 but only imports AnantaLogo on line 5. This crashes the app for any owner without ananta_onboarded=1 in localStorage (fresh login → red 'Something went wrong' error boundary). BLOCKING for first-time owner UX. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/WebOnboarding.jsx:65

issues: Banner img reports naturalWidth=0 immediately after overlay open (loading=lazy artifact); renders correctly visually. Not blocking.
Promo image (portrait 784x1168) is very tall on the 390px web preview and dominates the top of the Account screen; expected on the wide preview, fine on a real phone (per task note).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/WebOnboarding.jsx to add `import AnantaTrident from "@/components/AnantaTrident";` (or replace <AnantaTrident/> at L65 with <AnantaLogo/>). This currently crashes the entire app for owners who haven't completed onboarding.
Optional: Add fallback if promo image fails to load (currently no onError placeholder in ComingSoonPromo.jsx).
critical_code_review_comments: Backend /api/promo/coming-soon uses a single shared document (key='coming-soon') — global state, not per-user. That is fine for a single-owner app but will need per-user isolation before multi-user rollout.
POST /api/promo/coming-soon/waitlist accepts empty body and still marks waitlist_joined=true (email optional). Consider requiring email once multi-user.
ComingSoonPromo.jsx (web) and ComingSoonPromo.tsx (mobile) duplicate the FEATURES list — consider a shared source of truth to prevent drift.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for promo feature; blocked pre-existing WebOnboarding bug bypassed

seed_data_creation: Cleared db.promo_state.coming-soon between tests to exercise waitlist_joined=false→true transition.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints GET /api/promo/coming-soon and POST /api/promo/coming-soon/waitlist are working. Web + mobile UI for the Coming Soon promo is functional end-to-end (banner+section+modal+join+dismiss+persistence). The WebOnboarding AnantaTrident missing-import bug is UNRELATED to this feature but MUST be fixed — after fix, retest fresh owner login (with localStorage cleared) to confirm the app doesn't crash. Backend regression: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter60_promo_coming_soon.py.
rca of the issue: WebOnboarding.jsx bug RCA: file imports AnantaLogo (line 5) but references <AnantaTrident/> at line 65. Fix by either (a) adding `import AnantaTrident from '@/components/AnantaTrident';` at top, or (b) replacing <AnantaTrident/> with <AnantaLogo/>. Repro: clear localStorage, log in as owner — WebOnboarding renders → ReferenceError → ErrorBoundary shows 'Something went wrong'.
